businessGoal: Allow users to filter products by brand for improved navigation

scenarios.goal: Verify that the brand filter is displayed on the product overview page.
Verify that selecting one or more brand checkboxes updates the product grid to show only products from the selected brands.
Verify that when one or more categories are selected along with one or more brands, the product grid shows only products matching both filters.

manual.reason: The story involves user interactions and UI behavior which require manual testing.

api.reason: The filtering behavior can be validated through the application's API capabilities.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria describe visible UI behavior related to the brand filter.
